description.en: Turn status notifications for Chrome OS, Windows and macOS: completion, approval, question and error alerts through the Web Notification API, a silent in-app toast fallback when the browser blocks them, and a 7-segment DeepSeek peak/off-peak countdown chip gated to official routes. No local app, ports, files or audio engine.
description.zh: 面向 Chrome OS、Windows 和 macOS 的回合状态通知：通过 Web Notification API 发送完成、审批、提问和错误提醒，浏览器拦截时回退为无声应用内提示，并在官方路由上显示 7 段式 DeepSeek 峰值倒计时芯片。不使用本地应用、端口、文件或音频引擎。
